book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso bɛ Sakio
Jiso gɛɛŋ wu lee a kinlaantɛŋ ki Jɛliku le, wu fede.
Muh mu gɛ̀ bee yo jee che nyu lɛ Sakio, nyu chiji kikwɛɛ ki bamii ba koode ŋwa, nyu tɛ muh wu kwa.
Wu gɛ̀ goone ki wu yɛ̂ŋ Jiso le no wu fede. Geenɛ, fi ya wu nje wu gɛ̀ kfufe lo, kinchvu ki bamii baŋe wu.
Wu mo wu legɛ wu gɛɛŋ fwe, wu gɛɛŋ wu bɛɛŋ yi kite kimi le lɛ Jiso ge doo wu fede wu yɛŋ wu le. Nje wu gɛ̀ bee ki wu fê je yo.
Jiso gɛɛŋ wu bu fo, wu noŋ ajii wu yɛŋ wù le fɛwe, wu tɛɛŋ wu lɛ,

content.text: “Sakio, shîlɛ chige wo tô, nje ŋkɛme ki nche a wo yeh a bɛŋ.”

content: Wu mo wu tɛɛshɛ lo wu shii yi kite kɛɛ le, wu fi Jiso bɛ kinlaŋye.
Bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ yɛŋ no Jiso gɛ̀ gɛɛne bɛ wu, bo mo bo kɛ bo tu bo shuŋshi bo duu lɛ, “Muh wunɛ gɛɛne wa ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu che bɛ muh wù befe wunɛ.”

Lɛ bo doo bo gɛɛŋ bo nyume Sakio ja wu lɛɛŋ we wu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Tada, bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, nlé ŋgâ mwɛɛ mwaŋ antɛnɛɛ nya bamii ba kifufe le. Nɛ ŋgɛ̀ mbee nfi wa muh, tu nlé ŋkâasɛ nchvuu kiŋgane kinɛh, mwɛdɛ le.”
No Jiso yu noo, wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Yi abɛŋ le, nfi le wu to wa yeh kfunɛ, no chiji la chinɛ le tɛ mwa Ablaham.
Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh gɛ̀ to ki wu gôoŋ bamii ba le bo lɛsɛ wa, wu bvusɛ bo.”

content: Ŋgaŋ kune bige
No bamii gɛ̀ yege no Jiso jɛme mwɛɛ munɛ, wu ja wu mo wu gɛɛŋ fwe wu ma ŋgaŋ wumu bo le, nje gɛ̀ shɛshi wa shige wu lee Yɛlusalɛm, bamii kwaji lɛ segemu Nyo le wa ki wu kɛ̂ wu sage bvunfoŋ bwe.
Wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ̀ bee kife kimu, mwa nfoŋ wumu ja woŋ wuboo le wu gɛɛŋ woŋ wumu le, je yì ndefe le, lɛ ba gɛɛŋ ba ghaa wu nfoŋ le, fɛ wu kaasɛ wu to wu sage bvunfoŋ bwe.
Wu gɛ̀ doo wu jade, wu tɛɛŋ booŋ be ba lɛme ba yuufe, wu ga bige bo le kikɛɛ kikɛɛ, wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ kô, bɛŋ shɛ̂ɛ bɛŋ gêe waaŋ yu fɛ ntoo.’
Wu mo wu ja, bamii ba woŋ kwɛɛ le gɛ̀ bane wu baaŋ. Bo mo bo shɛɛ bo tuŋ bamii a wu jiŋ lɛ, bo gɛɛŋ bo du lɛ gɛ bo koŋe muh wɛɛ lɛ wu nyume nfoŋ wuboo gɛ.
Ba gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ gɛh ba ghaa wu. Sege wu gɛ̀ tu jiŋ wu nyu wu fi wa bvunfoŋ, wu du ba tɛɛŋ booŋ be ba lɛme baa ba wu gɛ̀ ga bige bo le, ki wu yɛ̂ŋ laa bo gɛ̀ shɛɛ bo ge waaŋ bo kɛmɛ mbe la.
Wù fwe to wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Chiji wese, kikɛɛ kuŋ ki bige kì wo gɛ nya mɛne, nle nshɛɛ ŋkɛme mbe yo bikɛɛ yuufe.’
Wu yu joŋ, wu chooŋe wu, wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Wo le mwa lɛme wù joŋe. No wo le wo shɛɛ wo kɛɛ ki wo bîjɛ fɛ fiɛɛ fì shige le. Noo, nlé ŋgɛ̂ɛ wo wo sâge bantɛ yuufe.’
Wù bii fo tɛ to wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Chiji wese, kikɛɛ kuŋ ki bige kì wo gɛ̀ nya mɛne nle nshɛɛ ŋkɛme mbe yo bikɛɛ bitɛŋ.’
Wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, ‘Nlé ŋgɛ̂ɛ wo wo sâge bantɛ batɛŋ.’
Mwa lɛme wumu to wu jɛmɛ fie lɛ, ‘Chiji wese, kikɛɛ kuŋ ki bige kinɛ nle nshɛɛ kaaŋ a nchaŋa yi nju le ŋgɛɛ.
Nchi gɛɛde nje wo tɛɛme ajiŋ, nfane wo. Wo gɛ̀ bee njɛ wo le wo gɛɛ sɛŋ, wo mo wo to wo jo lo. Doo nyume njɛ wo le wo mbooŋ fiɛɛ sɛŋ, wo mo wo to wo gweji lo.’

Chiji kikwɛɛ we jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, ‘Wo le mwa wù befe. Njɛmɛ wù bu jwe wo le le wu, wù nlé njo nsa wo yu. Wo gɛ̀ kee lɛ ntɛɛme ajiŋ, njode fiɛɛ njɛ nle ŋgɛɛ sɛŋ, nle njɛ mbooŋ fiɛɛ sɛŋ mo nto gweji lo.
Wo gɛ̀ doo wo kee noo, gɛ̀ ge la fɛ wo jo bige biaŋ wo gɛɛŋ wo gɛɛ a nchvu le sɛŋ, wu lɛ sege ŋkaasɛ nto nfi bɛ mbe?’
Wu mo wu jɛme bamii ba gɛ̀ lɛme mbebe ye le lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ fì kikɛɛ ki bige kiyu a wu le, bɛŋ nyâ muh wù kɛme bikɛɛ bi bige yuufe le.’
Bo kajɛ lo, bo jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Chiji kikwɛɛ, wù kɛme wa bikɛɛ bi bige yuufe.’
Wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ muh wù kɛme fiɛɛ lé ba nyû ba bîsɛ. Geenɛ muh wù kɛme gɛ, fì shige fì wù kɛme lé ba nyû ba fî lo a wu le.
Yi mɛɛse le, bamii baa ba gɛ̀ banɛ mɛ, bo faŋe lɛ keefɛ mɛ nyû nfoŋ wuboo gɛ, bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ tô bɛ bo bɛŋ yûuyɛ a mɛ jii.’”

content: Ba fi Jiso Yɛlusalɛm njɛ Nfoŋ
Ajiŋ ayu no Jiso gɛ̀ jɛmɛ mwɛɛ munɛ, wu mo wu ja wu tu wu saa fwe wu bɛɛne wu gɛɛne Yɛlusalɛm.
Sege wu gɛ̀ doo wu fɛɛse ntɛ wù Bɛfash bɛ wù Bɛtani le, bo nyume mbebe yi mbegɛ wu Bite bi Olif le, wu mo wu baa booŋ be ba ŋgoo bamu bafɛɛ wu tuŋ bo,
wu jɛme lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ ntɛ wù fwe wege le. Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ lese yo, bɛŋ yɛŋ mwa jaki le, ba shuudɛ wù muh gɛ baaŋ yu we a bɛɛŋ gɛ, bɛŋ faanyɛ bɛŋ to bɛ wu fɛnɛ.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ faanyɛ, muh nɛ le wu biih laa bɛŋ faanyi nje la lɛ, bɛŋ chvuu lɛ Chiji Kikwɛɛ goone lo.”

content: Booŋ ba ŋgoo baa gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ fiɛɛ fichii nyu gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no wu be jɛme.
Bo gɛ̀ doo bo faanyi mwa jaki wɛɛ, bamii ba gɛ̀ kɛme biih lɛ, “Bɛŋ faanyi mwa jaki wɛɛ nje la?”
Bo chvuu lɛ, “Chiji Kikwɛɛ goone ki wu bɛ̂ɛŋ yu.”
Bo mo bo jo bo to bɛ wu fɛ Jiso le, bo dɛŋ bikuŋ biboo yi jaki wuyu wɛɛ le, bo mo bo bɛɛŋsɛ Jiso yu we.
Wu ja wu gɛɛne, bamii dɛŋe bikuŋ biboo a je, wu fede yu.
Wu gɛɛŋ, lɛ wu fɛsɛ fɛ je yì bohge a mbegɛ wu Bite bi Olif le, kinchvu ki bamii be ba ŋgoo bachii jaŋɛ, bo tu bo wuule bo yuuse Nyo fɛwɛɛwe, nje biŋgha bi mwɛɛ bichii bì bo gɛ̀ yɛne le.
Bo tu bo wuule bo duu lɛ, “Nyo le wu noŋ kimbonɛ yi Nfoŋ wù too a jee chi Tada le. Nyiɛgee le fɛwe, bvukugɛ nyu bvu Nyo wù fɛwe le.”
Bafalashii bamu ba gɛ̀ bee a kinchvu kɛɛ ntɛnɛɛ mo bo ja bo jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, dû lɛ bamii buŋ ba ŋgoo banɛ bâŋ lo.”
Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ bo be baŋ lo, ata kanɛ wuule gɛh lo.”

content: Jiso doo wu bu mbebe Yɛlusalɛm le, wu bijɛ yo nɛɛ, wu kesɛ bɛ kwe,
wu tu taanyi lɛ,

content.text: “O Yɛlusalɛm, nɛ bɛŋ banɛ be kee fiɛɛ fì taŋlo fi to bɛ kimbonɛ fɛ bɛŋ le yi juu chi abɛŋ le! Geenɛ mɛɛse gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ kɛɛ gɛ.
Noo, bɛŋ kêe lɛ kife too lo ki bamii bena ba kimbanɛ lé bo nyû bo gê bo tô bo jôoŋ kitaŋ bo gɛŋ bɛŋ bo kɛnɛ, bo baŋ bɛŋ antɛŋ bimbe bichii.
Bo lé bo gê bo lêe bo lɛ̂ɛshɛ lo bɛŋ mo booŋ bena, bo sa yeh yene, tɛdɛ gɛ shɛɛ yi chimi le gɛ. Fi lé fi gê fi kôoshɛ noo, nje bɛŋ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ kife kì Nyo gɛ̀ to fɛ bɛŋ le gɛ.”

content: Jiso kuŋ bamii ba waaŋ fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ ki Nyo le
Jiso gɛɛŋ fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, wu kɛ wu kuŋe bamii ba gɛ̀ gese mwɛɛ fo,
wu duu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Fi le ba saŋ lɛ Nyo duu lɛ,
‘Yeh yaŋ le yeh yi buunɛ.’
Geenɛ bɛŋ kaasɛ yi tu ‘Bvuta bvu bachoŋ.’”

content: Jiso shee wu yɛyi bamii fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le aju achii. Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo, mo bamii ba baaŋ baaŋ ba yo tu bo weede ki bo yuuyɛ wu.
Geenɛ bo gɛ kɛmɛ je gɛ, nje bamii bachii gɛ̀ shee gɛh lo mbebe Jiso le, bo goone gɛ ki bo sho lo fiɛɛ fimimia fɛ mwɛɛ mù wu gɛ̀ yɛyi le gɛ.
